**Finding: deviation (high) — § 3.4 Termination for Convenience**

- **What's compliant:** Customer has a convenience right on one month's notice (effective at month end), and IBM has no convenience right anywhere in the Agreement — § 3.3 is for-cause only. That matches the preferred position on notice and asymmetry.
- **What deviates:** § 3.4(b) conditions the exit on uncapped "early termination charges" defined outside the Base Terms (Attachment A / Service Option Attachments), and nothing refunds prepaid charges — § 3.5 only accelerates Customer's accrued payment obligations.
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** § 3.4(b) now requires payment only of charges accrued through the termination date, bars any early termination charge or penalty, and requires IBM to refund prepaid charges for the post-termination period within 30 days. Comment offers a 3-months'-charges cap as fallback.
